item.title: Clean Architecture in the Age of AI-Generated Code: Why Structure Matters More Than Ever in 2026
item.description: I used to think good architecture was a taste thing — something senior engineers cared about and everyone else tolerated. Then I started letting an AI agent write 70% of my code, and within two weeks I understood exactly why architecture existed in the first place. Not as a rulebook. As the only thing standing between “the agent shipped a working feature” and “the agent shipped a working feature that quietly wired the payment service directly into the UI layer.
